# Continuity

Facts the text has established. Add as you draft; never contradict without a note.

## Names and ages

- Odile Nadeau is seventeen in January 1929. [ch01 §2]
- Wilfred Nadeau is her older brother and runs the cut. [ch01 §1]

## Dates

- The 1929 cut began on the ninth of January. [ch01 §1]

## Objects and places

- The tally book is a green ledger with a broken spine, kept on the scale house
  windowsill. [ch01 §2]
- The horse is called Dorcas and will not walk on ice she cannot hear. [ch01 §4]

## Who knows what

- Odile knows the cannery order was halved. Wilfred does not, as of chapter 1.
